paper.title_en: Challenging the hoop conjecture with spinning pancakes and baguettes
paper.abstract_en: Understanding when gravitational collapse produces a black hole remains a central challenge in general relativity. Black-hole uniqueness results characterize the stationary endpoint under suitable assumptions, while singularity theorems establish geodesic incompleteness in the presence of trapped surfaces and appropriate energy and global conditions. Neither, however, provides a general criterion for horizon formation. The hoop conjecture offers such a criterion by relating the enclosed mass to the compactness of a matter distribution in every direction. We construct axisymmetric families of initial data describing rotating dust and test a formulation of the conjecture adapted to this setting. We explore highly prolate and oblate configurations with both constant and differential rescaled angular-velocity profiles, including configurations near the threshold for apparent-horizon formation. We find that the conjecture holds for rotating configurations, with a coefficient within 14% of unity as in the nonrotating case, provided the quasilocal mass includes the rotational energy. If the irreducible mass of the apparent horizon is used instead, the deviations grow with spin, as they do for Kerr black holes. For horizonless configurations, the conjecture likewise holds when the mass is restricted to the energy enclosed by the matter surface, whereas using the ADM mass, which also includes rotational field energy outside the matter, leads to apparent violations of up to $\approx$25%. We also discuss the possible evolution of compact configurations without apparent horizons, their relation to weak cosmic censorship, and their implications for horizonless compact objects.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文直接检验箍假设与视界形成判据，构造轴对称旋转尘埃初始数据并分析质量定义的依赖性，属于广义相对论基础问题，理论深度较高且对宇宙监督有直接关联，值得点开细读。
decision.title_zh: 用旋转的薄饼与法棍挑战箍假设
decision.abstract_zh: 理解引力坍缩何时产生黑洞仍是广义相对论中的一项核心挑战。黑洞唯一性结果在适当假设下刻画了稳态终态，而奇点定理则在存在俘获面以及适当的能量与全局条件时确立了测地线不完备性。然而，二者都没有给出视界形成的一般判据。箍假设提供了一种这样的判据，它将所包围的质量与物质分布在各个方向上的致密度联系起来。我们构造了描述旋转尘埃的轴对称初始数据族，并检验了针对这一情境改编的一种该假设的表述。我们探索了具有常数与微分重标角速度剖面的高度长椭球与扁椭球构型，包括接近表观视界形成阈值的构型。我们发现，对于旋转构型，若准局域质量包含转动能，则该假设成立，其系数与 unity 的偏差在 14% 以内，与不旋转情形相同。若改用表观视界的不可约质量，则偏差随自旋增长，正如对 Kerr 黑洞那样。对于无视界构型，当质量被限制为物质表面所包围的能量时，该假设同样成立；而使用 ADM 质量（其还包含物质外部的转动场能）则会导致高达约 25% 的表观违反。我们还讨论了无表观视界的致密构型可能的演化、它们与弱宇宙监督的关系，以及它们对无视界致密天体的启示。
